status: APPROVAL PASS 2026-09-30, not shipped. Every sheet: scale 3, whole texels, never rotated, no dither.
offset_rule: offset = frame centre - pivot, in texels, for a centred Sprite2D at scale 3 (px = texels x 3). Grids read row by row: frame n is column n % hframes, row n / hframes.

greyson_doom_orb.pivot_is: the orb's FOOT, the bottom of its sphere: the same point on every stage, so it grows upward
greyson_doom_orb.anchor: foot = his crown (GreysonArtLayout.crown(anim)) + (0, -6) px; at HOME in a pose: (960, 296)

arrival_flash.rule: as a stage banks, show its f4 once, then loop f0-f3

greyson_doom_orb.stage_6: f0 is greyson_bomb f1 pixel for pixel, less the muzzle beam: the hand-off frame

hand_off.rule: move the orb's foot to the cannon's muzzle + (0, -9) px (tween it up with the arm), show stage 6 f0, then swap to greyson_bomb at frame 1 with its pivot on the muzzle and run the gather from there (f1-f15). Only the muzzle beam appears; nothing jumps.

greyson_doom_orb.keep_out: at HOME the tallest pre-bomb stage (5) with its haze and lightning tops out at y 188; the HUD block ends at y 180 over his head. Stage 6 only shows as the spirit bomb starts and the HUD goes. Fade the orb to 0.4 while the player overlaps it.

greyson_doom_orb_glow.rule: the same frame index as the orb, drawn under it on the same node

greyson_doom_orb_burst.place: on the orb's centre: its foot + centre_from_foot_texels[stage] x 3
greyson_doom_orb_burst.beats: f0 flash, f1 cracks, f2-f5 flies apart (the hurt is already over: it is the hit that pops it)

greyson_hype_streak.rows: heading row k = round(atan2(vy, vx) / 22.5 deg) mod 16 (screen axes, y down): row 0 flying right, 4 down, 8 left, 12 up; pick it each frame from the velocity
greyson_hype_streak.pivot_is: its head; the tail trails behind
greyson_hype_streak.flight: about 0.4 s from the crowd (the stands along the top, ringside down the sides) into the orb; on a hit, the same sheet flying back out to the crowd
greyson_hype_streak.alternative: greyson_hype_streak_cyan.png, identical layout, in the crowd energy cyan

greyson_doom_vignette.screen_layer: top-left (0,0) at scale 3, under the HUD
greyson_doom_vignette.rule: from stage 4: modulate alpha 0.5 at stage 4, 0.75 at stage 5, 1.0 as the bomb starts; a heartbeat lifts it +0.25 for 0.12 s then eases back over 0.3 s, about once every 0.9 s
